name: accounts
description: Identity + RBAC on the v4 substrate — owns the `accounts`/`roles`/`permissions`/`refresh_tokens` schema (relocated out of core), DrizzleEntityService, Hono routes, pluggable AuthProvider. Compose its `accountsSchema` fragment into `createApp({ schema })` and customize as needed.
postInstall: Add the schema to your composed schema: `createApp({ schema: { ...accountsSchema } })`
Wire the routes in src/index.ts, capturing the chained return so hc() types survive: `const app = defineAccountsRoutes(createApp({ schema }), { service, provider })`
Provide a service constructed against your composed schema: `new AccountService(app.db)`
Provide an AuthProvider (Firebase by default; Better-Auth/Clerk/WorkOS in v4.x)
